title: EY ML Playground
description: A no-code machine learning platform enabling data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, and results visualization without writing code.
longDescription: Built the flagship internal EY tool: a full-pipeline no-code ML platform with a React frontend and FastAPI backend. Covers Data Ingestion → Data Audit → Aggregation → Target Selection → Train/Test Split → Feature Selection → Model Selection/Tuning → Training → Results, governed by a CP×CC segmentation framework for model eligibility. Includes time-series models (ARIMA, SARIMA, ARIMAX) via statsmodels/pmdarima, hyperparameter tuning (Random/Grid/Bayesian via scikit-optimize), a Multi-Scenario Predictions Playground with CSV ingestion, Oracle/Tableau-style forecast visualizations with shaded confidence bands using Recharts, and a PostgreSQL-backed model history leaderboard.

title: Hospital X-Ray Locator App
description: An app to find nearby hospitals for X-ray services with timings, reviews, pricing, and an integrated AI chatbot.
longDescription: Designed an application to help users locate nearby hospitals offering X-ray services, surfacing service timings, reviews, and prices. Includes maps and search, a booking system, pricing logic, predictive ML for wait-time/availability, an integrated AI chatbot for user queries, and a payment system.

title: ATS Resume Scanner
description: A tool that scores resumes against job descriptions using ATS-style keyword and formatting checks.
longDescription: Built a resume analysis tool that parses uploaded resumes and job descriptions, then scores match quality using keyword overlap, section/formatting checks, and skill-gap detection — similar to how real Applicant Tracking Systems filter candidates. Surfaces actionable suggestions to improve ATS pass-through rate.
